data.one_liner: Type‑safe Dart implementation of daisyUI components for Jaspr, using a fluent API.
data.what_it_does: Deepyr maps daisyUI components to Jaspr widgets, providing a type‑safe, chainable API for building web UIs with Tailwind CSS. It supports responsive breakpoints and minimal runtime overhead.
use_when: Building web apps with Jaspr that use Tailwind CSS and daisyUI
Need compile‑time style safety and fluent modifier syntax
avoid_when: Projects that do not use Jaspr or Tailwind CSS
When you need a different UI kit or framework
strengths: Type safety catches styling errors at compile time
Fluent API allows intuitive chaining of modifiers
weaknesses: Still under active development; backward compatibility not guaranteed before v1.0
Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and daisyUI v5 to be configured
Limited to Jaspr; not usable with Flutter widgets
data.setup_notes: Add deepyr to pubspec, install Tailwind CSS v4 and daisyUI v5 in your Jaspr project, then import deepyr and use its components.
